decisions.reason: The underground LHD loader was launched only in 2018 and fits squarely with the firm's announced focus on specialized mining and tunnelling equipment, and the firm has sunk engineering investment and public commitment into it, so weak early results would be read as temporary ramp-up effects rather than a reason to exit.

The underground dump truck complements the loader in a mining fleet offering, carries recent development costs and visible website commitment, and is too new for disappointing results to justify withdrawal, so management would persist with it.
